title: Welcome screen with enlarged monogram
slide_intent: Use a large identity element to frame an arrival message because greeting and recognition can share one surface.
strategic_value: An oversized monogram can turn a utilitarian display into a recognizable welcome point.
demonstration: A vertical black screen carries a white cropped angular mark around a short welcome message.
practical_value: Study the hierarchy between a large graphic frame and a compact message.

content_islands.name: Graphic frame
content_islands.spec: White angular strokes occupy the upper and lower display.

content_islands.name: Welcome message
content_islands.spec: A small stacked greeting sits within the black interior.

content_islands.name: Screen housing
content_islands.spec: The freestanding display locates the design in the lobby.
